name: 👑 Odaenathus
era: declared king after Edessa 260; defeated Sasanian Persia on Rome's behalf; assassinated 267

name: 👑 Vaballathus
era: ten-year-old child king under his mother Zenobia's regency; took the title Augustus late 271

name: 👑 Zenobia
era: de facto ruler co-regent with Vaballathus; conquered Egypt 270; captured by Aurelian, Palmyra fell 272

name: 👑 Antiochus
era: relative of Zenobia declared Augustus in the 273 revolt; Aurelian razed Palmyra
